title: Instrumental 3: С + Instrumental (With)
titleRussian: Творительный 3: С + творительный (с кем? с чем?)
description: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental for accompaniment. Today: с другом, с мамой, с молоком, plus neuter -о → -ом.
descriptionRussian: Предлог 'с' (with) употребляется с творительным падежом и обозначает совместность.
intro: One preposition and one very sharp distinction. With no preposition, the instrumental means you used something as a tool. With с in front, it means you were accompanied by it. Cutting bread with a knife takes the bare form; walking with a friend takes с. Get those the wrong way around and you have said you walked using a friend.
rules: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental case to mark ACCOMPANIMENT: с другом (with a friend), с мамой (with mom), с молоком (with milk).
Neuter nouns ending in -о take -ом in the instrumental: молоко → молоком, мясо → мясом, окно → окном. The ending is identical to the masculine hard pattern.
Neuter nouns ending in -е take -ем: море → морем, поле → полем. The ending is identical to the masculine soft pattern.
Before consonant clusters starting with с-, з-, ш-, etc., с becomes со for ease of pronunciation: со мной, со школой. The case stays instrumental.
Critical contrast: с + instrumental is for ACCOMPANIMENT (Я гуляю с собакой = I walk WITH a dog). Tools take BARE instrumental, no с (Я пишу карандашом, NOT с карандашом).
examples: Я иду с другом. (I'm going with a friend.) друг → другом, после с.
Маша гуляет с мамой. (Masha walks with her mom.) мама → мамой.
Антон пьёт чай с молоком. (Anton drinks tea with milk.) молоко → молоком.
Лена ест хлеб с маслом. (Lena eats bread with butter.) масло → маслом.
Соня поёт с тётей. (Sonya sings with her aunt.) тётя → тётей.

items.hint: Recall L2: feminine -а becomes which ending?
items.explanation: Warm-up from Lesson 2. The pen is the INSTRUMENT, taken by bare instrumental (no с): -а → -ой → ручкой. Today's с + instrumental marks accompaniment, not tools.

items.hint: С takes which case? Друг is masculine.
items.explanation: С (with) takes the instrumental: друг → другом.

items.promptEnglish: Masha is walking with her mom.
items.explanation: С + instrumental: мама is feminine -а → мамой.

items.hint: Молоко is neuter -о. Neuter -о takes the same ending as masculine hard.
items.explanation: Neuter nouns ending in -о take -ом in the instrumental, just like masculine hard consonants. Молоко → молоком. After с the case is fixed; the only question is the ending, which depends on gender.

items.hint: Сахар is masculine. Apply the L1 hard-consonant rule.
items.explanation: Сахар is masculine consonant + -ом → сахаром. After с the case is always instrumental.

items.hint: Names follow noun rules. Лена ends in -а; what's the feminine instrumental ending?
items.explanation: First names decline like common nouns. Лена is feminine -а → Леной.

blanks: Маша гуляет с _____. (Masha walks with her dog.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Собака is feminine -а. After с, the case is instrumental: -а → -ой → собакой.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Masha writes a letter with a pencil.
errorCorrection.explanation: A TOOL takes the bare instrumental with no preposition: пишет карандашом. С (with) marks accompaniment (a person or thing you are together with), not the instrument of an action. 'Писать с карандашом' reads as if the pencil were a companion.

errorCorrection.sentence: Вчера я гулял с друг в парке.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Yesterday I walked with a friend in the park.
errorCorrection.explanation: С (with) governs the instrumental for accompaniment: с другом. Друг is hard masculine + -ом. С друг leaves the bare nominative, which never follows a preposition.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон любит кофе с молоко по утрам.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton likes coffee with milk in the mornings.
errorCorrection.explanation: С (with) takes the instrumental, and neuter nouns ending in -о add -ом (the same ending as hard masculine): с молоком. С молоко leaves the bare nominative, which cannot follow a preposition.

minimalPairs.explanation: After с (with), the noun must be in the instrumental: другом. The nominative друг would mark a subject ('Друг здесь' / 'The friend is here'), not the person you are travelling with.
After с, the noun goes in the instrumental: молоком. The nominative молоко would only mark a subject ('Молоко в холодильнике' / 'The milk is in the fridge'), not the thing accompanying the tea.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each с + instrumental phrase by the gender of the noun.

reviewVocab.definition: with (takes the instrumental for accompaniment); becomes 'со' before consonant clusters
neuter gender (nouns ending in -о or -е; in the instrumental they take -ом or -ем)
accompaniment, togetherness (the meaning carried by с + instrumental)
reviewVocab.example: Маша гуляет с мамой — здесь 'с мамой' выражает совместность.
